name: Lim Wei Jian
bio:
Lim Wei Jian is a seasoned finance controller with over two decades of experience managing complex financial portfolios. His career began in corporate banking, but a lifelong passion for motorsport led him to seek opportunities within the industry. He joined Garage 59 five years ago, drawn by their commitment to excellence and cutting-edge technology.

Wei Jian is known for his meticulous approach to financial planning and his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance. He believes in fostering open communication between the financial team and the technical staff, ensuring that budgetary decisions are aligned with the team's strategic goals. His demanding nature ensures fiscal responsibility and accountability across the organization.

What sets Wei Jian apart is his ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for the engineering and management teams. He uses his deep understanding of motorsport regulations to optimize financial strategies and maximize the team's competitive advantage.
